name: @qdnbd/dsh-panel-pins
description: Take over the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: collect every panel row and third-party plugin entry into one searchable, grouped launcher — in-menu search with hit highlighting, keyboard navigation, Alt+1..9 direct jumps — mirrored by a Ctrl+K command palette with a Recent (MRU) group and named layout presets that re-apply your whole arrangement in one click. Pin / top / reorder, hide or rename any row (floating editor that survives the sidebar's constant re-renders — no lost input), custom panel groups, icon-only rows, a compact footer, and a full Settings page with height sliders, a locale-safe whitelist and settings export/import. Display-layer only: no DOM surgery, clean uninstall, theme-token styling.
author: QDNBD
